firstPlayerRule: Players draw cards; the highest number deals. The person to the left of the dealer starts play.
houseFallback: If players tie for the highest number, those players draw again.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Mattel service-site instruction PDF and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 1: "The person who draws the highest number deals." "LET’S PLAY The person to the left of the dealer starts play." © 2008 Mattel.
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for equal high draws.
